name: billed_amount
description: Total amount on bills for the service month, VAT included, before disputes

name: bills_issued
description: Number of bills issued for the service month

name: billed_customers
description: Distinct customers with a bill in the period. Not additive across months.

name: arpa
description: Billed amount divided by distinct billed customers in the same period (ARPA). Over several months it is not a monthly figure.

name: disputed_amount
description: Amount under dispute on bills for the service month

name: net_due_30

expression.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN collection.matured_30 THEN collection.net_due END)

description: Amount due minus open disputed amounts, for bills issued in the period whose due date plus 30 days is on or before the data cut-off

name: collected_30

expression.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN collection.matured_30 THEN collection.paid_30 END)

description: Payments received up to 30 days after the due date against bills issued in the period, duplicates removed, matured cohorts only

name: collection_rate

expression.sql: (SUM(CASE WHEN collection.matured_30 THEN collection.paid_30 END)) * 1.0 / (SUM(CASE WHEN collection.matured_30 THEN collection.net_due END))

description: Certified collection rate. Share of the net amount due on bills issued in the period that was paid within 30 days of the due date. Value basis, bill-month cohort, open disputes excluded, payments deduplicated, only cohorts whose 30-day window has closed.

name: bills_paid_on_time

expression.sql: COUNT(CASE WHEN collection.paid_on_time THEN collection.bill_id END)

description: Number of bills whose net amount was paid in full by the due date

name: on_time_payment_share
description: Customer care's view. Share of bills, by count, paid in full by the due date. Not the collection rate.

name: cash_collected
description: Payments received in the period, whatever bill they settle, duplicates removed (cash basis)

name: cash_collection_ratio
description: Finance's month-end view. Cash received in the month divided by the amount billed for the month. Mixes cohorts; not the collection rate.

name: complaints
description: Complaints opened in the period, by the region where the complaint was raised when grouped by complaint.region

name: billing_complaints

expression.sql: COUNT(CASE WHEN complaint.category = 'billing' THEN complaint.complaint_id END)

description: Complaints opened in the period whose category is billing

name: median_resolution_days
description: Median days from opening to closing, over complaints closed by the data cut-off

name: complaints_per_1k_lines
description: Complaints opened divided by active lines in the same period, times 1,000

name: data_gb
description: Data used by all lines in the period, in gigabytes

name: voice_minutes
description: Outgoing voice minutes in the period

name: active_lines
description: Distinct lines with a usage record in the period. Not additive across months.

name: data_per_line
description: Data used divided by active lines in the same period

name: session_data_gb
description: Data used in data sessions in the period, in gigabytes, from the session table

name: sessions
description: Data and voice sessions in the period

name: call_minutes
description: Voice minutes in the period, from the session table

name: lines_with_sessions
description: Distinct lines with at least one session in the period. Not additive.
